slides.title: Surface Laptop Ultra with Local AI
slides.subtitle: Hybrid AI for consultants on the go

slides.title: Consultant Workflows
slides.takeaway: Like a chef with two kitchens
slides.notes: Consultants draft client summaries using two AI lanes. One for sensitive work, one for general use. This analogy helps executives visualize the hybrid approach.

slides.title: Device Stack
slides.notes: The Surface Laptop Ultra is equipped with powerful local hardware to run AI models directly. This ensures speed and privacy for consultants.

slides.title: Work Process
slides.notes: Consultants use local AI for sensitive drafting, then switch to Microsoft 365 Copilot for review. This hybrid approach ensures both privacy and flexibility.

slides.title: Cloud vs Local AI

data.verdict: Local AI for secure, repeated drafting tasks

slides.notes: Cloud AI requires internet and sends data to the cloud. Local AI works offline and keeps sensitive data on device. This is key for consultants with restricted Wi-Fi.

slides.title: Model Capacity
slides.notes: The device supports 28 open models locally. This includes powerful models like Gemma and Qwen3-Coder for efficient drafting.

slides.title: Consultant Use Cases
slides.notes: This matrix shows where local AI fits best: high-frequency, high-privacy tasks like client summaries. These are ideal for local processing.

slides.title: Pilot Setup
slides.notes: The pilot will test the Surface Laptop Ultra with 10 users for two weeks. Metrics include task time, draft quality, and user experience.

slides.title: Key Value

data.sub: 1,200 consultants x 6 summaries x 46 weeks = 27,600 hours/year (estimate)

slides.notes: This is an illustrative estimate. Real savings will be measured in the pilot. The goal is to reduce time spent on drafting sensitive client summaries.

slides.title: Next Steps

data.ask: Let's enable consultants to work securely and efficiently on the go.

slides.notes: We propose a 2-week pilot with 10 users. This will validate local AI’s value for consultants working in restricted environments.
